title: Group chat outbox fan-out silently drops all errors
description: Message/set create to a group chat succeeds (HTTP 200) even when get_members fails or enqueue fails for some/all members. Trigger: group chat where get_members returns an error, or any member has no mailbox host. Bad behavior: message stored in DB with Pending state, no outbox rows created, never delivered, no retry possible. Direct chat path was hardened in this diff (KITH-orvy.5) but group chat path in message.rs:384-392 still uses if-let-Ok pattern discarding all errors. Asymmetric fix.
